title: Add users to the system: manual setup, invite link and import

cleanup_prepend.name: smazat zbylou CZ demo uživatelku 'Dvořáková Jana' (jana.dvorakova@example.com) z CZ běhu – jen při právě 1 řádku po hledání 'jana.dvorakova@example' a dialogu se jménem
smazat zbylou PL demo uživatelku 'Kowalska Anna' (anna.kowalska@example…) z PL běhu – jen při právě 1 řádku po hledání 'anna.kowalska@example' a dialogu se jménem

s01.narration: A new colleague is starting and you're not sure where to begin? Hi, I'm Maria from the Sloneek team, and I'll show you how to add users.

s02.narration: In the left menu, under Company, I expand Users and open Management.

s03.narration: Here you see all active users with their team, position, and roles. You can search by name, email, team, role, position, or tag.

s04.narration: You can add users manually with the Add button, send them a link with Invite, or import them from Google Workspace and Office 365.

s05.narration: Let's start manually. I click Add, and the Create a new user form opens.

s06.narration: First, the account status. Emily starts in a few weeks, so I choose The user is not active.

s07.narration: An inactive user can't log in, gets no emails, and you don't pay a license for them. It's the perfect state for preparing a new hire's start.

s08.narration: Only the name, surname, and email are required. I'll enter Emily Carter.

s09.narration: I enter her work email. Once she's activated, her invitation to Sloneek goes to this address.

s10.narration: The option to hide the email from other colleagues hides the address in the Colleagues section. It's handy for a private email, for example.

s11.narration: Special user rights add roles on top of a regular user. I'll open the list, but I won't select anything.

s12.narration: An administrator manages the whole app and sees all data. A document manager or an asset manager has full access only to their own module.

s13.narration: A reporting administrator can access all reports, and only the ombudsman can read the trust box. A regular colleague needs none of these.

s14.narration: I set the type of employment relationship to Employee. You can also choose contractor, freelance, or internship.

s15.narration: On the right are more work details. In the Date of joining the company field, I enter her first working day.

s16.narration: The start date is saved to the profile history. Sloneek doesn't calculate pro-rated leave on its own, though; you set that in the user's absences.

s17.narration: I pick the position from the list, here Customer Support Specialist. You can add new positions through the Manage positions link.

s18.narration: I add Emily to the Customer Support team. The team determines her manager and who approves her absences and attendance.

s19.narration: And the work location, here our Prague office. You can fill in the other details anytime later.

s20.narration: All done, so I click Create user. Sloneek immediately asks whether I want to assign a type of work contract.

s21.narration: The type of work contract sets her working hours, which her attendance and absence balances are calculated from. I choose Yes.

s22.narration: I select Full-time 40 h. It's valid from her start date, I tick Indefinite period, and save.

s23.narration: Emily now has her own user profile. The header shows she's still inactive.

s24.narration: The tabs hold personal information, contract and payroll, absences, documents, assets, and the change history.

s25.narration: The Contract and Payroll tab shows her full-time contract. You can also add remuneration here.

s26.narration: You set managers and approvers in the Teams section. If a team has no manager, administrators approve the requests.

s27.narration: Before you activate Emily, check her language. In the Notifications and Integrations tab, English is already set, so I just confirm it and save.

s28.narration: Her invitation and the app will be in English. When Emily starts, open Actions and choose Activate.

s29.narration: Once activated, she gets an email with a link to set her password, sees her assigned documents, and you start paying her license.

s30.narration: Back in the overview, I switch the filter to Only inactive. Emily is here, ready for her first day.

s31.narration: The second way is Invite. Sloneek creates a company link that you can send to colleagues by email or in a chat.

s32.narration: Colleagues use the link to create their own accounts and fill in their details. You then review them and activate the accounts.

s33.narration: Import users brings people in from Google Workspace or Office 365. For a bulk import from Excel, our support team will prepare it with you.

s34.narration: A final tip: when you create an inactive newcomer, you can assign them a new hire packet, so they fill in their details before their first day.

s35.narration: Now you know how to add users manually, invite them with a link, and bring them in with an import. If something doesn't work, check the Help Center.

s36.narration: Less admin, more time for people. This is Sloneek.
